# v2.31-dev Release Notes

## Fixes & small improvements

Three fixes around students and the Training Data admin page.

### Fixed

- **Student edit — Country no longer wrongly flagged "needs theatre."** When you
  edited a student, the Country dropdown could show a misleading, cut-off
  "(needs theatre — fix in Region Data)" note against a country whose Theatre
  was actually configured. That happened when the country list hadn't finished
  loading yet. Now the note only appears once the list has loaded and only for a
  country that genuinely has no Theatre set — and the wording is shortened
  (`⚠ no theatre`) so it never truncates. While the list loads, the dropdown
  shows a brief "Loading countries…" placeholder instead of a false warning.

### What's new

- **Training Data — see at a glance which ILTs / OLXs grant a certification.**
  On **Admin → Training Data**, ILT and OLX entries that have a mapped
  certification now show a green **Cert** badge next to their name (hover to see
  which certifications). On a Full Title's detail page, the mapped-titles table
  gains a **Certification** column showing a "N cert(s)" badge per training —
  so you no longer have to open each row in edit mode to check.

- **Training Data — your filters survive opening a training.** On
  **Admin → Training Data**, your search text, column filters, "show legacy
  only" toggle, and sort direction are now remembered when you open a training
  and click **Back** (they're also reflected in the page URL, so the view is
  bookmarkable).

### Notes

- No database changes, no configuration changes. Nothing to do after updating.
